what: A board of staggered-height photo columns flows left and right following the horizontal mouse position (overflow width × ratio, .05 per frame, returns to center when the cursor leaves). Rolling the wheel makes each column follow deltaY/2 with a different duration (.5/.8/.2/.3/.6s power3), so they stagger (up to half the column height). After 3 seconds idle at the top, the columns sink 70px one by one (1s power1.inOut, photo turns off at .9s), swap the first photo for the next, and rise back (turns on at .85s, cell background changes to the new photo’s dominant color in .5s) — .62s between columns, 3s rest after a full round. While it runs window.lenis is paused, and if the wheel was rolled in the meantime it stops at the end of the round

options.lerp: Rate at which the panel follows the mouse (per frame), default .05
options.min: Minimum window width (px) at which the panel follows the mouse, default 992
options.lags: Duration each column follows the wheel (seconds, comma-separated), default .5,.8,.2,.3,.6
options.wheel: Column shift per 1px of wheel, default .5
options.idle: Seconds until the wheel starts turning at the top, default 3
options.wait: If event, hand reactions and the spin stay paused until the host fires an fx:start event on the panel (starts after the intro)
options.[data-fx-part=track]: Panel with overflowing width (required) — flows with the mouse
options.[data-fx-part=col]: Pillar (must exist) — rises with the wheel. A hidden pillar (display:none) is dropped from the wheel
options.[data-fx-part=media]: Photo cell inside the pillar — the first two sink. Receives the data-tint of the swapped photo
options.[data-fx-part=next]: Next photos hidden at the end of the column — they enter the first cell in turn and the photo that leaves goes back to the end. With data-tint, the cell background takes that color
